title: Ride the Rides
intro: Welcome in to Disney Jeopardy! Please keep your arms and legs inside the vehicle at all times, because tonight we are riding the rides. Coasters, dark rides, and songs you can't get out of your head.

categories.title: To Infinity and Beyond
categories.intro: Our film category has inspired more rides than I can count. It's Pixar's Toy Story films. Reach for the sky!

clues.clue: What is the name of the boy who owns Woody and Buzz in the first Toy Story?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Andy. His name is literally written on Woody's boot. Free points.

clues.clue: The three-eyed aliens in the Pizza Planet crane game worship what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Claw. It moves. It chooses who will go and who will stay. Ooooh.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 2, Woody learns he was the star of which 1950s TV show?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Woody's Roundup. Yodel-ay-hee-hoo! Jessie, Bullseye, and the Prospector were all there too.

clues.clue: What is the name of the toy store owned by Al, the toy collector in Toy Story 2?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Al's Toy Barn. Bonus points if you can do the chicken suit commercial voice.

clues.clue: What is the name of Sid's scary dog in the first Toy Story?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Scud. Buster is Andy's dog. Scud is the reason no toy wants to visit the neighbors.

categories.title: Coaster Crazy
categories.intro: This category is for the thrill seekers. Hands up for some Disney roller coasters!

clues.clue: Seven Dwarfs Mine Train in Magic Kingdom is themed to which classic film?
clues.answer: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
accept: snow white and the seven dwarfs
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs. Heigh-ho, heigh-ho, it's off to the standby line we go.

clues.clue: Expedition Everest at Animal Kingdom is guarded by which legendary snowy creature?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Yeti. He is giant, he is angry, and he really does not want you on his mountain.

clues.clue: Slinky Dog Dash zooms around which land at Disney's Hollywood Studios?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Toy Story Land. You are shrunk down to the size of a toy in Andy's backyard. Watch out for giant Woody.

clues.clue: On Magic Kingdom's TRON Lightcycle Run, riders lean forward on vehicles shaped like what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is lightcycles. It's one of the fastest coasters at Walt Disney World. Hold on to your hat. Actually, put the hat in the locker.

clues.clue: Space Mountain first launched riders in 1975 at which Disney park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Magic Kingdom. Disneyland didn't get its own Space Mountain until 1977. Florida was first for once!

categories.title: Ride Tunes: Finish the Lyric
categories.intro: Sing it with me! I'll give you a lyric from a classic attraction song, and you finish it. Bonus points for singing out loud.

clues.clue: Pirates of the Caribbean: Yo ho, yo ho, a pirate's life for ___.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is me. A pirate's life for me! Drink up, me hearties, yo ho.

clues.clue: Walt Disney's Enchanted Tiki Room: In the Tiki Tiki Tiki Tiki Tiki ___.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is room. All together now, in the Tiki Tiki Tiki Tiki Tiki Room!

clues.clue: It's a Small World: It's a world of laughter, a world of ___.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is tears. A world of hopes and a world of fears, too. Very emotional for a boat ride.

clues.clue: It's a Small World: There's so much that we share, that it's time we're ___.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is aware. It's a small world after all. Sorry, it's going to be in your head all week.

clues.clue: Haunted Mansion: When the crypt doors creak and the tombstones quake, grim grinning ghosts come out to ___.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is socialize. Even ghosts need a party. Grim Grinning Ghosts was sung by Thurl Ravenscroft and friends.

categories.title: Which Park Is It In?
categories.intro: Every one of these attractions is at Walt Disney World. Your job? Tell me which of the four parks it calls home.

clues.clue: At Walt Disney World, Test Track lets you design and test your own car in which park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Epcot. Zoom zoom. Just like real life, your car design is probably not as good as you think.

clues.clue: At Walt Disney World, Kilimanjaro Safaris takes guests on a bumpy ride past real African animals in which park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney's Animal Kingdom. Every ride is different, depending on which animals are awake.

clues.clue: At Walt Disney World, The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror drops guests in a haunted hotel elevator in which park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney's Hollywood Studios. Check in to the Hollywood Tower Hotel. Check out is optional.

clues.clue: At Walt Disney World, Remy's Ratatouille Adventure shrinks you down to rat size in which park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Epcot, in the France pavilion. You get to scurry through Gusteau's kitchen in 3D. Delicious.

clues.clue: At Walt Disney World, The Barnstormer, a junior coaster starring Goofy as a stunt pilot, is in which park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Magic Kingdom, over in Storybook Circus. Great first coaster for the little ones.

categories.title: All Aboard!
categories.intro: Club DJ chose ride vehicles! Teacups, doom buggies, honey pots. Tell me what you're riding in, or who's driving.

clues.clue: On the Mad Tea Party, guests spin around in giant what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is teacups. Pro tip, do not eat a turkey leg right before this ride.

clues.clue: On Peter Pan's Flight, guests soar over London in a flying what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a pirate ship. Think happy thoughts and sprinkle a little pixie dust.

clues.clue: The ride vehicles in the Haunted Mansion are known as what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Doom Buggies. Please keep your hands inside, the hitchhiking ghosts are watching.

clues.clue: At Magic Kingdom's The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh, riders bounce along in giant what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is hunny pots. Spelled H U N N Y, the Pooh way. Oh bother.

clues.clue: Mickey and Minnie's Runaway Railway is a wild train ride. Which character is the train's engineer?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Goofy. Which explains why the train ends up literally everywhere but on the tracks.
